decision.reason: [ev-9337091e0b36] is only a one-line changelog entry. It says the "On deployed" trigger must now account for a race between the last transition time and the sync finished time. It does not say which configurations use or are affected by this trigger (applicability), and it does not say what goes wrong before the fix or what changes after it, such as missed or duplicate notifications (consequence). The linked issue #9070 or PR #21944 would be needed to write those aspects.
